chunks: Wahb ibn Wahb narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, peace be upon him, who said:
ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever acquires more bondwomen than he can marry or give in marriage, then the sin is upon him if they commit immorality.”

key_terms.يَنْكِحُ: to marry in a lawful marital arrangement

ai.seo_question: Is a person sinful for keeping more bondwomen than he can lawfully marry off or manage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal and moral warning regarding the acquisition of bondwomen beyond one’s capacity to lawfully manage their marital status. It places responsibility and sin upon the owner if their neglect leads to their falling into immorality.
